_metadata.description: Requirements for the typed Storage Manager headroom projection.

requirements.title: Typed storage headroom reader
requirements.description: Infrastructure Manager MUST read the typed Storage Manager feed and expose H1 through H6 with an explicit trust verdict for each reading.

validation.notes: The storage source adapter and trust mapping are covered.

requirements.title: Unavailable storage stays unavailable
requirements.description: When the Storage Manager feed is unavailable or stale, the instrument MUST report unavailable and MUST NOT fabricate a healthy zero reading.

validation.notes: Unavailable and stale source behavior is covered.

requirements.title: Growth trust reflects census attribution
requirements.description: Infrastructure Manager MUST mark H2 untrusted when the latest census is stale or unattributed bytes exceed ten percent of measured bytes.

validation.notes: The storage reader test covers materially unattributed census bytes.
